description: AI workers for Skilled Nursing and Senior Living Operations. Founded in 2025 by Adityavardhan Agrawal and Arnav Agrawal, Morphik has 2 employees based in San Francisco.

founders.name: Adityavardhan Agrawal
founders.title: Founder
founders.bio: Building Morphik. Prev @MongoDB, worked on scalable database algorithms. Graduated Cornell University in 2022.

founders.name: Arnav Agrawal
founders.title: Founder
founders.bio: I was one of 3 students in all of India to receive the Tata Scholarship, which allowed me to study Computer Science at Cornell. I dropped out to build Morphik after experiencing terrible RAG and enterprise search first-hand during my co-op at Amazon Robotics. While there, I developed a configuration compiler that sped-up deployment of the Sparrow and Cardinal stations to new locations.   I also developed and taught a course in ML Operations and AI as an undergrad at Cornell.
